newsitem.title: UK: BFI up two to 994 as Panamaxes firm slightly.
newsitem.headline: BFI up two to 994 as Panamaxes firm slightly.

text.p: The Baltic Freight Index (BFI) rose two points to 994 Thursday, the first rise since Aug 23.

Brokers said marginally firmer conditions for Panamaxes, especially in the Far East, have been seen today and a better volume of chartering enquiry generally leading brokers to believe that the Panamax market at least is now coming off the bottom.

Meanwhile Cargill have fixed 60,000 heavy grain US Gulf to Continent for Oct 4/11 at an unchanged $8 and were also believed to have covered 54,000 tonnes heavy grain US Gulf to Japan Oct 18/25 at $19 no combo, the same rate as fixed for this position by Dreyfus two days ago but 25 cents more than fixed overnight by Halla with Top Trader for Oct 16/28.
Grain business for Handy Sizes from the Continent and the Lakes was active, brokers said.

Longer term views of the market may be influenced by news Thursday that the International Grains Council in a monthly statistical report cut its estimate of world 1996/97 world wheat trade by one million tonnes from its previous estimate to 88 million.
BIFFEX was slightly easier with active positions two to seven points lower in a turnover of 89 lots
